- Calculates 0.04% of the amount due for each day overdue
- Returns 0 if the invoice is not overdue (dueDate >= asOf)
- Applies to the amount still due (after payments and discounts)
- Rounds to the nearest cent

Formula: `fee = amountDue × daysOverdue × 0.0004`

All 253 tests pass (added 10 new tests for lateFee).
